description.narrative: The intervention will reach 10,684 number of individuals/ ca. 2,400 households with a focus on supply of safe water, sanitation, hygiene promotion with an emphasis on risk reduction for cholera transmission, as well as the distribution of non-food items (NFIs) to cover immediate needs in four camps in Blantyre.
The project will benefit 10,684 individuals corresponding to about 2,400 households temporarily housed in four camps in Blantyre. The proportion of females (55%) is higher than that of males (45%).

WHH will support its partner organization Waste Advisors in launching their emergency operation in Blantyre District. This initial support will focus on WASH and cholera prevention in camps housing people displaced by teh effects of cyclone Freddy.
